query:
INSERT INTO receipt_queue
                    (message_id,  chat_id, mimi_id, status, created_at)
                SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5
                WHERE NOT (
                    ?4 = ?6 AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM receipt_queue
                        WHERE chat_id = ?2 AND mimi_id = ?3 AND status = ?7
                    )
                )
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
